thought.text: The standalone failure was because `setup-docu-data` deletes ressorts 99/9901. Let me test the actual "create Fachplanung" POST manually.

reasoning_content:
9901 was deleted by setup-docu-data (the radical cleanup deletes 99 and 9901). So the 030 test fails because the standalone run didn't have 99/9901. In the full sequence, 01-infrastruktur_setup creates 99/9901 first. In my full-sequence run, 030 failed at "Neue IT-Fachplanungen anlegen" step... wait, in the full run, 01 passed creating 99/9901, then 030 test 1 passed (create 2027 gesamtplan), test 2 failed - alert-info not visible. Let me look closer.

Actually, in the full ordered run, 030 had 1 passing and 1 failing. The failing was "R1 initiiert die Fachplanungen für 2027" — expected `.alert-info` visible but got `d-none`. Interesting: in standalone run (after reset), it failed earlier at checkbox fp-9901 not found (because 9901 deleted). In full run, 9901 exists, checkbox found, then save, then alert-info expected visible.

Wait, but in standalone the first test recreated... no, standalone test 1 only creates gesamtplan 2027, not dienststellen. So 9901 missing → fail. In full run, 99/9901 present but the alert-info assertion failed.

Let me think: the test checks `input[name="btn-save"]` first, invokes removeAttr disabled, click. Then `.alert-info` should be visible. But the template's alert-info has class `d-none`. The success message added via `$this->addHtmlMessage(..., 'info')` renders as a separate `.alert-info`. Hmm but maybe there are two `.alert-info` and Cypress `.should('be.visible')` matches the hidden one first.

Actually in the standalone run earlier (before my reset), 030 gave "1 passing, 1 failing" with the d-none alert-info error at line 39. Line 39 is the `.alert-info` check. So the issue: after clicking save, the page may redirect or the message. Let me test manually by submitting the form via curl to see if addFachPlanung works.

Let me manually POST ds9901 to neue-fachplanungen/2027.

action.command: cd /workspace; echo "== page before =="; curl -s -b /tmp/cj3.txt -c /tmp/cj3.txt "http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/administration/it-gesamtplan/neue-fachplanungen/2027" -o /tmp/fp.html -w "%{http_code}\n"; grep -oE 'id="fp-[0-9]+"' /tmp/fp.html | head -20; echo "== POST ds9901 =="; curl -s -b /tmp/cj3.txt -c /tmp/cj3.txt -o /tmp/fp2.html -w "%{http_code}\n" -d "ds9901=on&btn-save=Fachplanungen+anlegen" "http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/administration/it-gesamtplan/neue-fachplanungen/2027"; grep -oE 'erfolgreich angelegt|Fehler[^<]*|alert-[a-z]+' /tmp/fp2.html | sort -u | head; echo "== DB fachplanung =="; su - ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && ddev mysql -e "SELECT * FROM fachplanung;"' 2>&1 | tail -10
